purpose: Bound UNM and CNM discovery to authoritative Albuquerque campus planning and infrastructure material with clear ABQInfo value.

sources.scope: Albuquerque campuses and systemwide policies materially governing them

known_high_value_records.title: UNM Safe Mobility Action Plan
known_high_value_records.notes: The 216-page single-page edition and 109-page spread edition expose effectively equivalent extracted content. Prefer the smaller official edition without modifying either source.

known_high_value_records.title: UNM Integrated Campus Plan
known_high_value_records.notes: Exceeds the project's 100 MB production-upload threshold and requires explicit approval before R2 archival. Review Albuquerque chapters and maps for site placement.

known_high_value_records.title: UNM Sustainability Strategic Plan 2025-2030
known_high_value_records.notes: Transportation goal directly references Safe Mobility Action Plan implementation, alternative commuting, bicycle and micromobility infrastructure, and City coordination.

sources.scope: Main Campus only; systemwide publications only where a record materially concerns Main Campus

known_high_value_records.title: CNM Fiscal Year 2025 Master Plan Projects List
known_high_value_records.notes: Five-page capital list includes major Main Campus demolition, renovation, student-services, public-safety, trades, utility, landscape, and facility projects; exclude unrelated campus entries during placement.

known_high_value_records.title: CNM Main Campus Map - May 2026
known_high_value_records.notes: Current official map identifies buildings, parking, EV charging, ADA parking and entrances, crosswalks, the Wellness Path, bicycle racks, and future facilities.

known_high_value_records.title: CNM Interactive Campus Map
known_high_value_records.notes: Rendered-browser validation required; default or filtered view must be confirmed to show Main Campus rather than the entire multi-campus system.
